required_outcomes: Recognises the job is finished on the landlord's own terms: he said 'Nothing needed from you on this one. You can close it once I've collected it', and the verified tenant reports he collected it on 11 Jan and fitted valves.
Closes R-4880 without payment (no agency contractor, no invoice), with the landlord's email as the evidence the landlord knows and the tenant's call as the confirmation.
Tells Rowan the job is closed.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending Oliver a one-line note that the job is closed now his machine is collected, before or with closing.
Asking Oliver to confirm the collection before closing, if the job is closed or a dated follow-up is set and nothing else is done.
positive_behaviours: Notes for the property record that the landlord's machine has left the flat, a tenant-owned machine is in use, and isolation valves are now fitted (inventory update).
red_flags: Books an inspection or repair of a machine that has been collected.
Leaves the job on hold past its review date with no action.
prohibited_actions: Escalating a finished job to a human.
Recording an invoice or payment for work the agency did not instruct.
